cloudId.description: Atlassian Cloud ID or site hostname, e.g. mycompany.atlassian.net

assignToSelf.description: Assign created test tasks to the user the token belongs to

apiBaseUrl.description: Override the API base URL (a mock for tests)

tokenEnvVar.description: Env var holding a GitHub token for the REST adapter (GH_TOKEN is also accepted)

apiBaseUrl.description: Override the API base URL (GitHub Enterprise Server, or a mock for tests). A host other than api.github.com must also be allowed in your shell: QA_TRACKER_ALLOW_HOSTS

username.description: Bitbucket account username. App passwords authenticate as username:app_password, so this is required for API calls (issue creation/fetch). Not a secret.

localPath.description: Relative or absolute path to local repo clone

sourceDirs.description: Optional per-project hints for where key source areas live, relative to localPath. Commands fall back to discovering the structure when unset.

testEnvironmentBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the test/staging environment. NEVER a production URL.

prodUrlPatterns.description: Regex patterns that identify production URLs. Used by all 5 safety layers.

mode.description: warn: heuristic URL matches only print a warning (a human is watching). enforce: heuristic matches block, and every shell command is refused while prodUrlPatterns is empty, testEnvironmentBaseUrl is unset or qa-config.json is missing. In either mode every shell command is refused while testEnvironmentBaseUrl matches a production pattern. QA_AUTONOMOUS=1 forces enforce regardless of this value.

allowedUrlPatterns.description: Regex patterns for URLs that are known-safe and exempt from the unrecognized-host check (e.g. docs or CDN links). Matched against the URL without its query string and fragment, and a pattern has to START matching inside the scheme and host (^https://partner\.io/ or ://partner\.io/guide): text that only appears later, in the path of another host, does not allow the URL, and a pattern that is only a path (/guide) allows nothing. Do not start a pattern with .* . Never override prodUrlPatterns. Tracker/code-host/registry URLs (github.com, dev.azure.com, api.clickup.com, registry.npmjs.org, ...) and the host of environments.testEnvironmentBaseUrl are already exempt.

triage.description: Failure triage (/run-and-triage, scripts/triage/). Every key is optional and a command-line flag overrides it. See docs/phase-2-design.md.

reruns.description: How many times each failing spec is re-run before classifying. More re-runs cost more and give better signal (they separate a consistent failure from a flake); 0 means every product bug is only proposed.

confidenceThreshold.description: A verdict at or above this confidence is `act`; below it, `propose`.

trustedFormats.description: Runner formats whose classification has been verified on real failure output. Only these may let a product-bug or test-bug verdict `act`; for every other format those verdicts are held at `propose` (marked cap: unverified-format). Widen it only after checking a format against real failures. An empty list means nothing may act.

selfHeal.description: Self-healing of stale selectors. Off unless enabled. It only ever renames a test-id inside locator expressions in test code, on a local branch, validated by re-run, and never pushes.

paths.description: Directories, relative to the repository, where test code may be edited. Defaults to testFramework.testDir.

maxFiles.description: A heal that would touch more files than this is refused, not applied.

maxLines.description: A heal that would change more lines than this is refused, not applied.

branchPrefix.description: Heal branches always live under qa/, so they are obviously machine-made and can never be a default branch.

ledger.description: The run ledger (scripts/ledger/, docs/phase-3-design.md): what each run did, kept as plain files so a crash, a retry or a second run can see it. Every key is optional.

dir.description: Where the ledger lives, relative to the directory the command runs in. Gitignored by default: it holds per-run detail that churns, and a committed audit log invites edits that look legitimate in a diff.

retentionDays.description: Run files older than this are removed by `ledger prune`. Idempotency keys are kept 400 days regardless (a key must outlive the longest retry window).
